question_text: Explain why DDL is needed to implement an agreed database model, giving one suitable command.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: DDL defines the schema in the DBMS. CREATE TABLE can turn a modelled entity and attributes into a table with columns and key constraints.
